description: We're a team from Trujillo, Peru: 2 statisticians and 2 computer scientists tackling Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots. We'll merge 20+ years of NASA FIRMS fire data into one consistent series and build a web app with a burning-activity calendar, so emergency responders can compare current fire activity against historical patterns. Our strengths: statistical modeling, time series, data processing and web development. We speak Spanish and English.
